metadata.short_desc: WhatsApp Web Gateway adapter with QR login.
metadata.desc: AstrBot platform adapter for WhatsApp Web/Baileys, backed by a local Gateway with QR login, DM/group access control, and media support.

gateway_host.hint: Keep 127.0.0.1 unless AstrBot and the Gateway run in different containers.

auto_start_gateway.hint: Starts the Node.js Gateway when the plugin page is opened. Platform instances have their own adapter config.

node_executable.hint: Node.js 20+ is recommended, for example node or /usr/bin/node.

auth_dir.hint: Empty means data/astrbot_plugin_whatsapp_adapter/whatsapp-auth under AstrBot's working directory.

allow_from.hint: Used by platform instances that keep the built-in default. Use E.164 numbers like +15551234567. Use * only if you intentionally accept all DMs.

dm_policy.hint: Used by platform instances that keep the built-in default. allowlist only allows allow_from; open requires allow_from to contain *; disabled rejects DMs.

group_policy.hint: Used by platform instances that keep the built-in default. disabled by default. allowlist checks group_allow_from or allow_from.

group_allow_from.hint: Used by platform instances that keep the built-in default. Falls back to allow_from when empty.

groups.hint: Used by platform instances that keep the built-in default. Use WhatsApp group JIDs like 120363...@g.us. Use * to allow all groups.

mark_online.hint: Marks WhatsApp Web as online/available after connecting. Disable for invisible-style operation.

media_max_mb.description: Default media size limit in MB

whatsapp-login.title: WhatsApp Login
whatsapp-login.description: View Gateway status, scan the WhatsApp Web QR code, restart the connection, or log out.
